verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs describe Skills as modular instruction sets that extend the agent for specific tasks. Each skill packages guidance, processes and optional resources, and Cline loads it only when relevant to the request, which directly matches equipping the agent with specialized skills. missing for 10: documented details on how developers author and install their own custom skills (format, location, sharing), independent or hands-on corroboration of skills working in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
